tests.requirement: Battery housings from which gases can escape during charging or discharging are ventilated to prevent unacceptable RISK from accumulation of gasses and possible ignition
Battery compartments designed to prevent accidental short circuiting of battery when this could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION as described in clause 13.1
Means provided to prevent incorrect connection of polarity when a HAZARDOUS SITUATION may develop by incorrect connection or replacement of a battery
Overcharging of battery prevented by virtue of design when it could result in an unacceptable RISK as verified by review of design
Primary lithium batteries comply with IEC 60086-4
Secondary lithium batteries comply with IEC 62133 or IEC 62133-2

Properly RATED protective device provided within INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE to protect against fire caused by excessive currents when layout of internal wiring, cross-sectional area, rating of connected components can result in a fire
Protective device has adequate breaking capacity to interrupt the maximum fault current
Justification for OVER-CURRENT RELEASES or FUSE exclusion is documented
Short circuit test between the positive and negative poles of an INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE between the output and protective device(s) omitted where 2 MOOPs provided

Short circuit between the positive and negative poles of an INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE between the output and protective device(s) does not result in any HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in clause 13.1
Indicator lights provided to indicate ME EQUIPMENT is ready for NORMAL USE, except when apparent to OPERATOR from normal operating position, and marking of 7.4.1 are insufficient for this purpose
An additional indicator light provided on ME EQUIPMENT with a stand-by state or a warm-up state exceeding 15 s, except when apparent to OPERATOR from normal operating position
Indicator lights provided on ME EQUIPMENT incorporating non-luminous heaters to indicate heaters are operational when a HAZARDOUS SITUATION could exist
Requirement not applied to heated stylus-pens for recording purposes
Indicator lights provided on ME EQUIPMENT to indicate an output exists where an accidental or prolonged operation of output circuit could constitute a HAZARDOUS SITUATION
Colours of indicator lights complied with 7.8.1
Charging mode visibly indicated in ME EQUIPMENT incorporating a means for charging an INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE
RISKS associated with pre-set controls addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS when applicable as verified by review of RISK MANAGEMENT FILE
Actuating parts of controls of ME EQUIPMENT
a) Actuating parts cannot be pulled off or loosened up during NORMAL USE
b) Controls secured so that the indication of any scale always corresponds to the position of the control
c) Incorrect connection of indicating device to relevant component prevented by adequate construction when it could be separated without use of a TOOL
When torque values per Table 30 applied between control knob and shaft of rotating controls for not less than 2 s, 10 times in each direction, knobs did not rotate
Tests conducted by applying an axial force of 60 N for electrical components and 100 N for other components for 1 min when an axial pull was required in NORMAL USE with no unacceptable RISK

Stops of adequate mechanical strength provided on rotating/movable parts of controls of ME EQUIPMENT where necessary to prevent an unexpected change from max to min, or vice-versa, of the controlled parameter
Torque values in Table 30 applied 10 times in each direction to rotating controls for 2 sec

regulations.description: Medical electrical equipment general safety standard

semantic_fragments.content: Clause 15.4.3.3: Overcharging of battery prevented by virtue of design when it could result in an unacceptable RISK. Result remark indicates 'No charging' - device has no internal charging function, hence N/A.

Clause 15.4.3.4: Primary lithium batteries must comply with IEC 60086-4 and secondary lithium batteries must comply with IEC 62133 or IEC 62133-2. Result remark indicates 'No Lithium batteries' - device does not use lithium batteries, hence N/A for both sub-requirements.

Clause 15.4.3.5: A properly RATED protective device must be provided within INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE to protect against fire caused by excessive currents (short circuit scenario). The protective device must have adequate breaking capacity to interrupt maximum fault current. Short circuit test between positive and negative poles assessed. Where 2 MOOPs provided, test may be omitted.

Clause 15.4.4: Indicator lights requirements for ME EQUIPMENT covering: ready-for-use indication, stand-by/warm-up state exceeding 15s, non-luminous heater operation, output existence indication, colour compliance per 7.8.1, and charging mode indication. All sub-clauses are N/A for this device as there are no non-luminous heaters, no such output, and no internal charging.

Clause 15.4.6.1: Actuating parts of controls tested for: (a) resistance to being pulled off or loosened during NORMAL USE; (b) control scale indication always corresponding to control position; (c) prevention of incorrect connection of indicating device to relevant component without a TOOL; (d) torque test per Table 30 applied to control knobs (10 times each direction, ≥2s); (e) axial force test - 60N for electrical components, 100N for other components for 1 min. Results indicate 'No control knob' - relevant tests N/A.
